news.title: Full year 2026 earnings released: EPS: ₹9.12 (vs ₹7.51 in FY 2025)
news.body: Full year 2026 results: EPS: ₹9.12 (up from ₹7.51 in FY 2025). Revenue: ₹142.4b (up 26% from FY 2025). Net income: ₹70.2b (up 27% from FY 2025). Profit margin: 49% (in line with FY 2025). Revenue is forecast to grow 24% p.a. on average during the next 2 years, compared to a 1.7% growth forecast for the Banks industry in India. Over the last 3 years on average, earnings per share has increased by 25% per year but the company’s share price has increased by 39% per year, which means it is tracking significantly ahead of earnings growth.
